units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 5:7">Gitt. V, 7</cite> <he>חרש רוֹמֵז ונִרְמַז</he> a deaf-mute person may transact business by gesticulating and being spoken to by gestures (with hands and head, contrad. to <cite ref="S01764"><he>קָפַץ</he></cite>).
Gen. R. s. 93 ר׳ למנשה he motioned to Manasseh; a. fr.—Trnsf. to intimate, hint.
<cite ref="Shabbat 113b:10">Sabb. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>רֶמֶז רָ׳ לה וכ׳</he> he intimated to her that &c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:15:4">Cant. R. to I, 15</cite> <he>רמז רָמְזָה לנח וכ׳</he> she (the dove, by bringing an olive leaf) hinted to Noah, as if saying &c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="T00800">same</cite>. Ib. to I, 9 <he>והיתה מְרַמֶּזֶת וכ׳</he> she motioned to her captors saying to them, I am yours &c.
to be spoken to by gestures, v. supra.
